description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Movok Taltho)
- Vendor B (Mocasdra Fensan)
- Vendor C (Lucas Neume)
- Vendor D (Ozhesk Ozcasso)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

agents.shard_text:
Vendor A (Movok Taltho):
  - Vendor A has a stable engineering team
  - Vendor A is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor A includes free data migration
Vendor B (Mocasdra Fensan):
  - Vendor B offers straightforward contract exit terms
  - Vendor B refuses to include an uptime guarantee
  - Vendor B passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor B is financially stable
  - Vendor B currently serves 6 hospital clients
Vendor C (Lucas Neume):
  - Vendor C uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor C offers support only during business hours
  - Vendor C charges extra for data migration
  - Vendor C allows no customisation
  - Vendor C reported 1 major outages last year
Vendor D (Ozhesk Ozcasso):

  - Vendor D imposes heavy penalties for contract exit
  - Vendor D allows workflow customisation

  - Vendor D estimates deployment will take 3 months
